statement: let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ Y : ℕ, 2 ≤ Y → (@Finset.filter ℕ (fun n => ∃ p k : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ 3 ≤ k ∧ n = p^k) (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) (Finset.range (Y+1))).sum (fun n => Λ n) ≤ C*(Y:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)*Real.log (2+(Y:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0056 · 给三次及以上真素数幂分配三次根预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0056 · Bound the log mass of prime powers of exponent at least three

brief.zh: 按指数层求和，底数均不超过 Y^(1/3)，指数层数至多 log Y/log 2。跨指数重复出现时保留上界方向。
brief.en: Sum over the exponents. The bases are at most Y^(1/3) and there are at most log Y/log 2 exponent levels. Repeated images only increase the upper bound.
